statement: Pinned Linux DS4 Bluetooth initialization asks for calibration feature 0x05 of length 41 with feature CRC validation and uses Bluetooth-specific calibration word ordering; it attempts firmware 0xA3 but tolerates failure. Pinned SDL official Sony Bluetooth calibration reads feature 0x02 before 0x05, with fallback uncalibrated scaling if unavailable. Neither source authenticates retail calibration payload contents.
